title: Row Counter Stall Points
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=knitcompanion:counter rows_completed=* pattern_name=*
| sort 0 pattern_name _time
| streamstats current=f last(rows_completed) as prev_rows by pattern_name
| eval row_delta=rows_completed-prev_rows
| where isnotnull(prev_rows) AND row_delta<=0
| stats count as stall_events by pattern_name
| sort - stall_events
description: Finds patterns where row counts repeatedly stop advancing between sessions.
value: Stall points usually indicate a confusing instruction block, a fit issue, or a project that has lost momentum.
implementation: Sync knitCompanion counter history into Splunk and compare consecutive row values within each pattern.
visualization: Table of patterns with repeated row-count stall events.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which knitting projects keep getting stuck on the same part instead of moving forward.
